source: Stock path (deploy.websocket_server.infer_observation on deploy.policy.vla_policy.Policy, zero noise) on the worker, through the jpeg decode the server does. Images: frames of the ABC repo's assets/bottles_real.mp4 (Apache-2.0) as Playground Serve's client sends them (letterboxed to 224, JPEG q90): top = the frame at 5 s, left and right = crops around each arm at 8 s and 11 s (stand-ins for the wrist cameras). The RTC case sends the first 4 zero-noise actions + 0.01 as action_prefix.
bounds_note: fast against live stock with the same noise: the compiled graph body moved actions by 0.002 to 0.005 mean and 0.010 to 0.033 max on an RTX 4090; a new noise draw moves them by 0.045 to 0.100 mean and 0.26 to 0.43 max
